items.overview:
Second-year high school student Rakuro Hizutome loves nothing more than finding so-called "trash games" and beating the crap out of them. When he decides to change things up by playing a new, "god-tier" VR game known as Shangri-La Frontier (aka. SLF), he does what he does best: min-maxes, skips the prologue, and jumps straight into action! Rakuro may be a seasoned gamer, but a meeting with an old rival will change the fate of every SLF player forever.

Clad in nothing but shorts and a bird mask, Rakuro (player name: Sunraku) launches into the world of SLF. Things are going well at first as he takes down a goblin, a bunny, and even a python. But then Sunraku comes up against a huge, hard-hitting wolf known as Lycagon the Nightslayer. Will Sunraku's years of "trash game" experience be enough, or is he about to suffer a rude awakening just a few hours into his SLF adventure?

items.overview:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

---
I reincarnated as the heiress of a powerful conglomerate family in a novel. The problem is, this world is about to be destroyed by monstrous viruses.

With nothing but money to spare, I quickly bought a mansion in the countryside to build a shelter to escape the monsters… But the world ended far sooner than I had anticipated. Damn it!  

=
On top of that, somehow, the male leads ended up trapped in my house with me. And these guys don’t seem to have any intention of leaving. Why do they look like they have no plans to go to the female lead?

“Who exactly are you?”

“You seem like someone who knew the world was going to end beforehand.”

They were full of questions about me, but I couldn’t answer them. They wouldn’t believe me anyway. Right now, all I see them as is a good source of labor.

“Alright, let’s work. You need to earn your keep for what you eat!”

If I can find the cure for the virus causing the apocalypse, this hellish time will finally end. So, until then, I’ll make use of the male leads and hang on!

=
But one problem has come up. It turns out that this old mansion I purchased is far more suspicious than I thought. What on earth is happening in my house?

items.title: Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryoukou
items.overview:
Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. 
So they hop aboard their Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. 
Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. 
But as long as they are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, 
whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. 
The experiences and feelings these two girls share in a world full of nothing give them something to live for…  
  
---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2019**
